name: district
description: Official administrative name of the district

name: province
description: Province or federal territory to which the district belongs
constraints: Allowed values: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Islamabad Capital Territory

name: headquarters
description: Administrative center / headquarters town or city of the district

name: area_sq_km
description: Total geographic area of the district in square kilometers

name: population_2023
description: Total enumerated population according to the 7th Digital Census 2023

name: population_2017
description: Total enumerated population according to the 6th Population Census 2017
constraints: Min: 0; Null for districts formed post-2017

name: population_1998
description: Total enumerated population according to the 5th Population Census 1998
constraints: Min: 0; Null for districts formed post-1998

name: population_density_per_sq_km
description: Population density per square kilometer in 2023

name: literacy_rate_pct
description: Overall literacy rate percentage of population aged 10 and above (2023)
